headline: Six SaaS posture connectors gain full onboarding steps: Okta, PagerDuty, Redis Labs, SAP Ariba, Sentry, Microsoft 365
summary_md:
- Five connector pages replaced the placeholder "follow the steps outlined in the configuration wizard" with the credentials, required permissions and numbered onboarding tasks: **Okta**, **PagerDuty**, **Redis Labs**, **SAP Ariba** and **Sentry**.
- **Microsoft 365** gained a collapsible **Security Posture** section covering Microsoft Entra app registration, the Graph application permissions to consent to, and the four onboarding tasks.
- Each new page names the account role the connector needs — PagerDuty Account Owner, Redis Labs Owner, a Sentry org member on a Business Plan — so these are prerequisites worth reading before an onboarding call.
- The additions carry copy-paste artifacts from the SaaS Security docs: five pages share an `aha-connector` heading anchor, Sentry opens "To access Harness", and several steps still say "SaaS Security" where they mean Cortex XSIAM.
- Remaining churn is casing only — **MuleSoft** and **Redis Labs** corrected "SAAS" to "SaaS".

highlights.title: Microsoft 365 documents the Entra service principal the Security Posture capability requires
highlights.detail: Tenant ID, client ID and client secret, with a warning that deleting the service principal fails all future scans and forces a re-onboard; the Entra app registration steps are listed out of order.

highlights.title: PagerDuty onboarding needs Account Owner credentials plus an IdP MFA secret
highlights.detail: Username, password, subdomain and service region (US or EU, read off the login URL), and an Okta or Azure AD 2FA secret when logging in through an identity provider.

highlights.title: Redis Labs requires two API keys, both created by an Owner
highlights.detail: An API account key that appears only once the REST API is enabled, plus a per-user API user key whose permissions are inherited from the user it is bound to.

highlights.title: Sentry is supported only on the Business Plan, with a two-scope personal token
highlights.detail: The personal access token needs `member:read` and `org:read` and no elevated role, but the account must belong to the organization being scanned.

highlights.title: Okta's API token inherits the permissions of the admin who created it
highlights.detail: Super Administrator for read and write, read-only administrator for read-only, alongside the admin instance URL in `https://<subdomain>-admin.okta.com` form.

highlights.title: SAP Ariba onboarding is realm-scoped and links out to the SaaS Security MFA docs
highlights.detail: Username, password and realm, plus the instance FQDN (s1.ariba.com or s3.ariba.com) for direct login or an Azure AD 2FA secret for IdP login.

items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: Adds a Security Posture onboarding section; the "Configure the Office 365" prerequisite heading is renamed to "Microsoft 365".
Adds API token and admin instance URL requirements plus two onboarding tasks, in a collapsible Security Posture section.
Adds Account Owner credentials, subdomain, region and IdP MFA secrets, plus two onboarding tasks.
Adds API account key and API user key requirements and three onboarding tasks; corrects "SAAS" to "SaaS".
Adds username, password, realm, FQDN and Azure AD 2FA requirements across five onboarding tasks.
Adds a Business Plan account-type requirement and a personal token scoped to member:read and org:read.
Casing fix only: "SAAS application" becomes "SaaS application" in the remediation sub-capability.
